name: Personal records
description: Purchases, travel, home, vehicles, admin records, and life logistics.
purpose: Provide a safe default for everyday records, purchases, travel, home, vehicle, and life-admin knowledge.
audience: Fresh Exomem users and anyone tracking personal logistics, household records, travel, purchases, or administrative documents.
beginner_description: Use this as the starter pack for everyday documents, purchases, travel, home, vehicles, and personal admin.
agent_instructions: Use this as the default when no stronger domain pack is selected. Route observed purchases, maintenance, mileage, and transactions through record_memory when a Record collection exists; use plan_memory only for an explicit household, travel, or life-admin goal, priority, or horizon. This is guidance only and selecting the pack creates nothing. Save external documents as Sources, preserve proof as Evidence, and compile only durable conclusions, solved problems, and reusable patterns.

suggested_workflows.title: Save a personal record
suggested_workflows.intent: Capture a document, purchase, travel detail, or administrative record.
suggested_workflows.route: record_memory(action=append or update) for a configured Record collection; use Sources or Evidence for the original document or proof

suggested_workflows.title: Find everyday documents
suggested_workflows.intent: Retrieve records by topic, person, trip, purchase, or household context.
suggested_workflows.route: record_memory(action=query) for bounded Record history; use ask_memory for compiled conclusions or original documents
suggested_workflows.example: Find the documents for the trip.

examples: Add this purchase to the equipment history.
Update the mileage on the car.
Add this transaction to the ledger.
Find the documents for the trip.
